user.title: Connect to E-jídelníček
user.description: Enter your canteen's E-jídelníček address (for example `school.example.cz`, with or without `https://`). Username and password are optional -- leave them blank to see only the public menu, without order and balance information.

data_description.base_url: The web address of your school's E-jídelníček canteen system.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-enter your E-jídelníček password
reauth_confirm.description: The stored password for {name} no longer works. Enter the current password to keep this entry working.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the canteen's E-jídelníček site. Check the address and try again.
error.invalid_auth: Login failed. Check the username and password and try again.
error.unsupported_site: This address does not look like an E-jídelníček site. Note that skolnijidelna.online and e-jidelnicek.cz are different, unrelated canteen systems that this integration does not support.
error.unknown: An unexpected error occurred. Check the Home Assistant log for details.
error.incomplete_credentials: Enter both a username and a password, or leave both blank for the public menu.

abort.already_configured: This canteen and account are already configured.
abort.wrong_account: This password belongs to a different account than the one being re-authenticated.

empty_public_menu.title: The public menu at {host} appears to be empty
empty_public_menu.description: This canteen does not publish its menu publicly -- {host} shows no dishes without logging in. Reconfigure this integration entry with a username and password to see the menu.

data_description.update_interval_hours: How often to refresh the menu and order data, in hours.
